source_snapshot.items: Check GPU Libraries is suitable for rocRAND
source_snapshot.procedure: Build ROCm/rocRAND and run `./benchmark/benchmark_rocrand_generate --engine all --dis all`.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: RPUC/CHANGED/HIGH; exact all-engine/all-distribution benchmark, immutable builds, loader/resource controls and per-result spec comparison required.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Loses the source benchmark breadth and quantitative results.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Restores exact scope and integrity controls.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Other GPU libraries do not cover random engines/distributions.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Requires expected engine-by-distribution coverage and detects skipped/unsupported combinations.

original_test_intent: Prove the approved rocRAND build operates across every supported engine and distribution and its generation results/performance meet the AMD GPU specification.
original_method: Build immutable compatible ROCm/rocRAND, enumerate the expected engine×distribution matrix for the pinned version, run the exact benchmark under bounded GPU monitoring, and compare completeness, errors and approved throughput/statistical outputs per combination.
manual_activity: GPU library owner approves pinned version, supported matrix and per-combination limits, supervises workload and decides verdict.
required_inputs: Benchmark output schema and quantitative/error oracle
Stable GPU identity and loader manifest
safety_requirements: Build/run isolated with verified loader hashes
Abort on error/hang/threshold; no retry to fill missing combinations
agent_execution_scope: Capture every combination and health result
Report skips/extras/errors without changing support list or verdict
engineer_actions: Disposition every combination and decide outcome

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A smoke/info command cannot exercise or account for the source's all-engine/all-distribution benchmark.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run `./benchmark/benchmark_rocrand_generate --engine all --dis all` from approved hashes and reconcile output to the expected full combination matrix.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Both `all` selectors and ROCm/rocRAND build steps are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Precompute expected engine/distribution rows, attach raw result/error/performance and flag missing/extra/unsupported combinations explicitly.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes 'all' coverage and AMD-spec matching measurable.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Library load or one generator smoke result is insufficient.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Benchmark performance depends on problem/default parameters; authoritative limits must match the pinned binary defaults or explicit settings.

project_override_considerations: Engineering defines supported combinations and which numeric correctness/statistical/performance fields constitute spec compliance.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title, procedure and command consistently target rocRAND all-engine/all-distribution suitability.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Artifacts, matrix and limits are supplyable prerequisites.

review_improvement: Turns the two `all` selectors into an auditable expected combination matrix so silent skips cannot pass.
independent_technical_reasoning: A benchmark can exit zero while reporting unsupported or skipped engines/distributions, and parsing only emitted rows hides missing coverage. The expected matrix must be established before execution. Each row needs its own status and relevant metric/error oracle, because one fast successful generator cannot establish suitability of every algorithm/distribution pairing.
